assumption_provenance: Original-scale MCA controlled in-vitro simulation; randomized point targets, body starts and advected obstacle density. Shared uncalibrated pressure flow and ideal independent actuators, not hardware or clinical validation.
randomization_description: Each episode independently samples four separated centerline point targets on distinct navigable branches, then five nonoverlapping robots, then 32 particles with one of three randomized branch-density modes. Anatomy fixed; targets more than 1 mm from branch endpoints, at least 1 mm apart. Identical explicit seed remains reproducible.
particle_model: Shared-flow finite-radius soft obstacle spheres. Actual overlap penalized per event (6) and per robot-second per particle (20); squared clearance cost within 0.15 mm adds advance avoidance feedback. No calibrated rigid collision response; overlap does not directly block motion.
observation_description: Original 76 features unchanged, including the four predicted-clearance obstacle slots and the existing nearest-target geodesic distance with its straight-line bearing. Appended 36: eight per remaining target (route bearing in the robot frame, geodesic distance, remaining mass fraction, assigned-to-me flag, robots sharing it, active mask) plus four summary features (remaining target fraction, own assigned geodesic distance, assignment valid, remaining task mass fraction). The route bearing and the allocation both come from the known-map route tables the geodesic distance feature already used; they are observations only. No waypoint, velocity, residual or guidance command is derived from them anywhere, so the action path stays the pure-RL Frenet unit-vector transform.
success_definition: Report complete four-target clearance and collision-free clearance separately. Collision-free clearance also requires all five robots retained. Team completion bonus only for collision-free clearance; contact can never be hidden by completion.
flow_provenance: Per-episode healthy-tree reference flow 15-25 uL/min. Actual occluded flow solved from fixed episode pressure with lysis feedback. Unmeasured controlled in-vitro assumption, not physiological MCA flow.
hydraulic_smoothing_provenance: Gaussian sigma 2.5 mm is a lumped hydraulic resistance surrogate, not clot geometry or contact extent; true contact remains both Euclidean and geodesic <=0.12 mm.
allocation_provenance: Balanced geodesic allocation solved once per remaining-target set (rectangular Hungarian covering every remaining target, surplus robots to their own nearest). Held between clearances because EXP_0013 measured per-step reallocation at -9.8pp. Deterministic, no RNG, no oracle of future state.
measured_motivation: On the EXP31 development layouts the straight-line bearing agrees with the true route direction at mean cosine +0.32 and points into the wrong half-space for 18.3 percent of robot-target pairs, and a nearest-target argmin leaves at least one target unclaimed in 58 percent of layouts. All 422 observed failures were time limits with robots still active and removal fractions clustered on whole targets.
potential_provenance: Own-target potential: distance to the target each robot already observes as assigned to it. EXP35 attribution (research/validation/EXP0035_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTION_20261001) found failures are long-range route following, not endgame contact: eval-only known-map substitution beyond 0.7 mm gave 87/96/95 vs 51/78/65, within 0.7 mm only 54/84/66. The mass-weighted potential averaged over all targets and gave negative shaping to 32 percent of robots moving toward their own target, with 0.075/mm left on the final target. Within one allocation this is a pure state potential; on the step the sticky allocation changes (a target was cleared) reassigned robots receive zero shaping, so finishing is never penalised. Scale unchanged (0.3); EXP36 showed x4 scale is harmful.
command_speed_provenance: Constant-speed actuator: nonzero commands execute at robot_speed_mm_s along the policy direction; an exactly zero command still stops. Motivated by EXP34 diagnostics: with one target left the routed policy commanded mean |a| 0.22-0.42 and approached at 0.06-0.10 mm/s; eval-only unit rescaling gave 57/60/44 vs 58/53/31 on the same 100 layouts. That probe changed execution and is not a reported result.
own_bearing_provenance: Appends the route bearing to the robot's OWN assigned target in a fixed position (3 columns after the v8 summary). In v8 that bearing only appears inside the target-indexed slot flagged mine, so its position changes with the allocation. EXP35/EXP39 measured action-to-own-route cosine 0.14-0.25 in navigation, while a known-map follower using the same bearing reaches 87-96 percent. Same vector, no new information, no command derived from it; the action path stays the pure-RL Frenet unit-vector transform.
action_prior_provenance: Structured policy, NOT pure RL: executed command = observed own-target route bearing + 0.5 x policy command, then the unit-speed actuator. The bearing is the same vector the policy observes in columns 112:115 (known-map next-hop route table, as already used by every observation since EXP34); no other state is read. Diagnostic probe (EXP0041_ROUTE_PRIOR_PROBE_20261001, diagnostic layouts): bearing alone 89/100 complete clearance, bearing + 0.3 x EXP40 seed43 policy 91/100. The policy learns the residual (avoidance, coordination, endgame).
